caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it sits on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with light brown exterior and pale pink interior, irregularly shaped.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface details and slight curling edges.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, red-brown rim edge.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
